description: Run any Scribase tool by name, including ones search_tools found that are not listed here. Same scopes, confirmations and limits as calling the tool directly.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, per its input schema, e.g. {"name": "nightly", "schedule": "0 3 * * *", "sql": "select 1"}.

name.description: Tool name as search_tools returned it, e.g. `schedule_create`.

name: call_tool
title: Run a tool by name
